input: str1 and str2 are lowercase-English strings, each of length in [1,1000]. Collections are ordinary finite dense arrays/lists, not subclasses, proxies, sparse/accessor-backed collections. Strings are ordinary/primitive strings. Every collection length and computed allocation size fits [0,4294967295], with padded sizes explicitly included. No concurrent mutation or built-in monkey-patching is allowed. Preconditions are not runtime-checked, and allocation/resource capacity or completion is not guaranteed by declared bounds. Python integer inputs are plain int, excluding bool.
return: A shortest common supersequence with explicit deterministic tie policy: reconstruct backward from the prefix-LCS table; when an unmatched str1 code point can be removed without decreasing LCS length, emit it first; otherwise prefer an unmatched str2 code point; otherwise emit the common final code point. Reverse the emitted sequence. Strings are indexed by Unicode code point.
mutation_aliasing: Inputs and caller-held aliases remain unchanged; working state is private. The Solution instance retains no state. All DP rows and the output character array are private and distinct; returned immutable-string identity is unspecified.
numeric: Suffix DP lengths lie in [0,m+n] with m+n <= 2000. Matching leading characters consume both suffixes; unequal characters consume one and use the smaller remaining optimum. Reconstruction follows those lengths, never concatenates candidate strings inside the DP, and uses no numeric sentinel. All integer inputs/intermediates remain within [-9007199254740991,9007199254740991]; no bitwise coercion is used.
complexity: O((n+1)*(m+1)) time and DP space, plus O(n+m+1) reconstruction/output storage for n,m code-point lengths. Full table and loops are charged.
source_accounting: The complete standalone source is 1180 UTF-8 bytes, including all helpers, wrapper, calls, annotations, comments, whitespace and newline. Every helper is included; any standalone solve adapter is separately charged.
evidence_boundary: Versioned Python source after retained full adapted replay failures. Domain/effect/order policy is explicit; syntax checks are not behavioral qualification. Exact new bytes require isolated replay, independent host oracle and full effect/type comparison. No M1 claim.

successor.reason: Versioned numeric-domain/effect/deterministic-order alignment after retained full adapted replay failure; fresh native qualification required.
